about.title: What I bring beyond the interface
paragraphs: Frontend development is my core focus, with React and TypeScript at the center. I also work with API integrations, Postman, and foundational SQL and MongoDB knowledge when a feature crosses the frontend boundary
With early-career professional experience, I contribute across implementation, UX refinement, testing, documentation, and support while keeping the product and its users in view

I organize the work, review designs and user flows, clarify open questions, propose an approach, implement the feature, and test the result with Vitest and Playwright. I also work with Git through focused atomic branches

I collaborate with design on UX improvements, with product on the clearest user flow, and with QA through direct application testing. When a feature is unclear, I review it with design first, then technical leadership and product
